title: Close out Phase 2: retro, and flesh out the next epic
description: Run the epic-close retro; compact .tick/learnings.md; verify the epic's acceptance item by item against the code; then pick the next feasible epic, read its rough scope, and partition it into child ticks including its own EPIC-SKELETON pair. Close the corresponding ticks-tracker items with the gate evidence.
closed_reason: Close-out complete. Retro at .tick/logs/herd/av8/RETRO.md with the verification table, what worked, what went wrong and 11 residuals. Learnings compacted to 121 lines with the provider-configuration rules that cost the most time to learn. Phase 3 created as epic 9pd from those residuals — not invented — with the three deferred ticks (4l2, 1ya, hk7) and the operator-gated pin merge (3ku) re-parented into it so they keep their history and the worker's own diagnosis of why it refused. Its acceptance is the honest version: the packages actually GONE from ticks, and a PRODUCTION epic rather than a demo.
